title: Persist the session-wide QR browser-access state

gates.name: QR browser-access repository tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_qr_browser_access.py tests/promo/test_result_session.py

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

verify.summary: Fresh independent functional, typecheck, lint and cleanup checks passed, but the required canonical persistence evidence is incomplete: the isolated suite opens new SQLAlchemy sessions without restarting PostgreSQL and re-reading the committed browser-access row.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#shared-browser-access-persistence RED: promo_sessions has no persisted shared browser-access timestamps or atomic first-open/repeated-scan/activity owner path; GREEN: the next linear migration and promo repository preserve the nullable pair, admit first open only strictly before the 30-minute deadline, reuse one row across concurrent phones, advance shared last_seen on every valid repeated scan and explicit activity, and never advance it on passive access; decisive comparison: controlled-clock concurrent repository results, row cardinality and persisted timestamps before/after restart; artifact: isolated database migration/repository evidence under .tasks/TASK-080-T3-FT-006-W1/.
purpose: Add the durable promo-owned state and repository operations required for one session-wide QR browser-access context.
success_outcome: A result session can atomically admit/reuse the shared QR access context, advance one last-seen timestamp on valid repeated scans or explicit activity, and enforce irreversible derived idle expiry without a per-device grant or scheduler.
anti_goals: Do not add a participant account, per-device grant row, access-state table, refresh token, expiry scheduler or cleanup job.
Do not change immutable session arrays, teaser order, N, QR issue time or display expiry.
Do not implement public phone routes, client rendering, purchase navigation or foreign Photo/processing writes.

forbidden_scope: Production PostgreSQL, MinIO, credentials and deployment configuration
Inventory, processing, serving_control and diagnostics mutable state
Plaintext QR tickets, cookies, personalized payloads or raw storage identities in logs or artifacts
stop_conditions: The accepted linear migration cannot use its execution-time direct predecessor without requiring a mutable exact-head assertion.
Shared access requires a new grant/access table, scheduler, cleanup job or foreign capability write.
Concurrent first-open/repeated-scan/activity cannot be proved with isolated disposable data, controlled server time and safe cleanup.
The nullable timestamp pair would permit last_seen without first_opened or revive an expired context.

constraints: Primary owner is promo under src/face_moment/promo/; use the existing face_moment.promo_sessions row and one sequential Alembic stream.
The migration must verify its direct down_revision, upgrade, downgrade and re-upgrade with unrelated prerequisite rows preserved; do not assert a mutable future head.
Fixtures use unique disposable session rows and controlled server time, prove safe rerun and restart persistence, and remove only task-owned data after each run.
Store only qr_ticket_hash_sha256; the opaque ticket secret and plaintext never enter PostgreSQL, logs or retained evidence.
invariants: browser_first_opened_at and browser_last_seen_at are both null or both non-null, with last_seen greater than or equal to first_opened.
First open is admitted only when server_now is strictly before qr_first_open_expires_at; exact-boundary and late access cannot revive the context.
All phones share one browser state row; every valid repeated scan and explicit participant activity advances browser_last_seen_at, while passive reads, media loads, polling and timers do not.
Expiry is derived from browser_last_seen_at plus 60 minutes and is not stored, scheduled or reversed by stale access.
verification_targets: Isolated migration/repository proof covers the nullable-pair constraint, one shared row across concurrent first-open, repeated-scan and explicit-activity updates, passive non-extension, exact 30-minute and 60-minute boundaries, restart persistence and no per-device grant or scheduler.
The state probe preserves immutable session ticket/issue/teaser/union/N fields and proves task-owned cleanup without foreign capability writes.
